meta.name: browser-cdp
meta.description: Use this skill when you need to control a Chrome browser via CDP (Chrome DevTools Protocol) to reuse existing login sessions. Covers: launching Chrome in debug mode, opening URLs, waiting for page load, evaluating JavaScript, taking snapshots, and extracting auth tokens. Trigger phrases: browser automation, CDP, agent-browser, 浏览器操作, 操作浏览器, Chrome CDP, 复用登录态, extract token from browser.

copy.tagline: 用 CDP 协议控制 Chrome 浏览器，复用登录态完成自动化操作
copy.fit_line: 适合你，如果需要用代码控制 Chrome 浏览器并复用已有登录会话
copy.tagline_en: Control Chrome via CDP to automate browser tasks with existing login sessions
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you need to programmatically control Chrome and reuse existing login sessions

howto.what: 装上后，Claude 可以控制你的 Chrome 浏览器，比如打开网页、提取页面文字、获取登录令牌，还能点击按钮或输入文字。
howto.when: 当你提到“浏览器自动化”、“CDP”、“操作浏览器”等关键词，或要求复用浏览器登录态时触发。

say.text: 帮我打开百度首页，然后提取页面标题。
say.note: Claude 会启动 Chrome 并执行操作。

say.text: 从浏览器里提取我的登录令牌。
在浏览器中点击登录按钮并输入用户名。

howto.what_en: After installation, Claude can control your Chrome browser to open URLs, extract page text, retrieve auth tokens, and perform clicks or typing.
howto.when_en: Triggered when you mention keywords like 'browser automation', 'CDP', 'operate browser', or ask to reuse browser login sessions.

say_en.text: Open Baidu homepage and extract the page title.
say_en.note: Claude will launch Chrome and perform the actions.

say_en.text: Extract my login token from the browser.
say_en.note: Claude will retrieve token from localStorage or cookie via CDP.

say_en.text: Click the login button and type username in the browser.
say_en.note: Claude will use snapshot to locate elements and perform click and type.
